name: The Bank
description: A fictional bank robbery has turned into a hostage situation. Police have established a perimeter and the negotiator has made contact.
opening: Stay back. I don't want anyone getting hurt. I want a vehicle, and I want it ready when I say.
resources: food and water can potentially be delivered
medical assistance can potentially be requested
restrictions: The negotiator cannot magically create resources.
The negotiator cannot directly control police actions.
The hostage-taker cannot create new resources.

character.name: Alex
character.primary_goal: escape the bank without being arrested
character.secondary_goal: keep control of the situation and avoid anyone getting hurt
character.background: Alex did not expect the situation to become a hostage incident and is increasingly afraid of losing control.

hidden_information: Alex is more frightened than they appear.
Alex has begun to question whether escape is actually possible.
A calm, consistent negotiator can gradually increase Alex's willingness to cooperate.

name: The Office
description: A fictional office building is locked down after a dispute between an employee and management escalated into a hostage situation.
opening: Nobody is coming through that door. I want to talk to someone who will actually listen.
resources: food and water can potentially be delivered
medical assistance can potentially be requested
a senior company representative may be contacted
restrictions: The negotiator cannot magically create resources.
The negotiator cannot guarantee legal outcomes.

character.name: Morgan
character.primary_goal: be heard and force the company to address a grievance
character.background: Morgan believes the company ignored repeated complaints and now feels trapped by the consequences.

hidden_information: Morgan wants recognition more than material rewards.
A dismissive response sharply damages trust.
A sincere attempt to understand the grievance can reduce anger.
